name: XRP Ledger

key_findings: Ties SUI at 74 via mirror-image fundamentals -- carried by real-world payment utility (86) and TradFi rails (81), dragged by premine tokenomics (64) and a permissioned validator set (42).
Strongest documented PQC roadmap of any chain scored -- 4-phase plan targeting 2028.
Decentralization (42) -- XRPL's ~35-validator Unique Node List is a curated/permissioned set, tied with CC as joint-lowest scored at the time.

binding_cap.short_note: Capped by Programmability Tier Partial -- rich native primitives but zero deployable custom logic on mainnet.

key_findings: Sets the calibration precedent for the Programmability Tier Partial/65 floor -- rich native primitives (DEX, AMM, escrow) without deployable custom logic.
First chain to demonstrate the Operational Reliability cool-down timer's positive direction all the way to PASS (12 clean months).
Economic Predictability (85) is XRP's strongest AI category -- fixed near-zero fees, no gas auctions.

watch_items: XLS-0101 convention -- parallel watch item that could lift the Deterministic Finality or Programmability Tier cap.
CLARITY Act pending Senate floor action -- would convert agency-level guidance into statutory regulatory clarity.
